chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad b. Sinan, from Abu al-Jarud, from a man from Abd al-Qays, from Salman (may the mercy of Allah be upon him),

that he passed by the graves and said: Peace be upon you, O people of the graves from among the believers and the Muslims. O people of the abodes! Do you know that today is Friday? When he returned to his house and slept and sleep overcame his eyes, a visitor came to him and said: And upon you be peace, O Aba Abdillah. You spoke and we heard. You greeted and we returned it. You said: Do you know that today is Friday? And we know what the birds say on Friday. He said: And what do the birds say on Friday? He said: They say: Holy, holy, our Lord is the Merciful, the King. Whoever swears by His name falsely has not recognized the greatness of our Lord.

key_terms.الرحمن الملك: The Merciful, the King — two of Allah's divine attributes
key_terms.المقابر: The graveyards, cemeteries where the deceased are buried
key_terms.قدوس: Holy, Most Holy — one of Allah's divine names (al-Quddus)
key_terms.يحلف باسمه كاذبا: Swears by His name falsely — taking a false oath in God's name

ai.seo_question: What did Salman al-Farisi experience when he visited the graves on Friday?
ai.summary: Salman al-Farisi visited the graveyards on a Friday and greeted the deceased believers, asking if they knew it was Friday. In a subsequent dream, one of the dead returned his greeting, confirmed they could hear him, and revealed that on Fridays the birds proclaim God's holiness and kingship, while condemning those who swear false oaths by His name.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Sinan from Abi’l Jarud from a man from `Abd al-Qays from Salman (rh).

He passed by the graveyards and said: Peace be with you, O believing men and women of the graves. O people of the homes! Do you know that today is Friday? When he went to his house and slept, someone came to him [in his dream] and said: And also with you, O Aba `Abdillah. You spoke and we heard. You delivered your salaam and we returned it. You said: “Do you know that today is Friday?”, and we [even] know what the bird says on Friday. He said: So, what does the bird say on Friday? He said: It says: “Holy, holy. Our Lord is the Merciful, the King. Those who lie whilst swearing by His name have not recognized His greatness.”
